div.div:
cap₂ ⊆ cap₁: caveats are HMAC-chained, so a hop can add restrictions but never remove one.
Every token is bound to its holder's Ed25519 key: a stolen token is useless anywhere else.
The model never decides its own access: authorize() does, before every call.
